led_count.evidence: Three red LEDs are clearly visible in a horizontal row on the breadboard.

resistor_count.evidence: Three resistors with blue/color bands are visible, each connected in series with one of the three LEDs.

led_polarity.evidence: The LEDs are red, and the flat side or leg length is not clearly distinguishable from this angle to determine polarity.

photoresistor.evidence: A small component with a serpentine pattern is visible on the right side of the breadboard.

photo_pin.evidence: A green wire connects the photoresistor circuit to the A0 pin on the Arduino.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The GND wire connects to the negative rail of the breadboard.
